title: perf(codex): take naming and confirmation off the spawn critical path
context:
A warm Codex spawn took ~7s to return. Two steps sat between turn/start
being accepted and the response, neither of which the user needs:

  thread/name/set     ~1.7s, a cosmetic label; turn/start takes only
                      threadId and returns in 1-2ms, so it never depended
                      on the name
  durability confirm  p75 ~5.0s, and nothing branches on the result -- all
                      33 unconfirmed spawns in telemetry still returned
                      ok=True

Both n
decision: Changed server.py, tests/test_codex_spawn_finalize_async.py, tests/test_smoke.py: added _codex_finalize_spawn_async, worker, SpawnFinalizeAsyncTests, setUpClass, _run_finalizer, fake_request, fake_confirm, test_confirmation_runs_before_the_rename; new dep(s): importlib, unittest; 1 new file(s).
